attack_flavor: Wiggles its nose, says hi, then bonks your shin with its little horn.
group_behavior: Appears alone or in pairs (1–2 per fight). If its partner falls, it hides behind its ears for one turn (skips its next attack).
special: None. It is the tutorial enemy: the first battle ever is a single rabbit.
art_brief: Feral wild rabbit with scruffy, matted gray-brown fur, crouched low and ready to spring. Exactly ONE sharp ivory horn juts from the center of its forehead. Glowing red eyes, ears swept back, bared buck teeth in a snarl, big clawed hind feet. It is a pest monster, never a white bunny or a pet.
animations: idle: low crouch, hackles bristling, nose twitch, ears flatten; attack: coils back, lunges horn-first, recovers into the crouch; hit: recoils with a squeal, fur puffed out; defeat: tumbles, then bolts off into the grass.
variants: Darker brown and dusty-gray palette swaps. Always ONE horn and red eyes.

attack_flavor: Pops out of the grass asking “谁?” (who’s there?), then puffs a sneezy cloud of sparkly spores.
group_behavior: Appears alone or with one horned rabbit. Never flees.
special: Sleepy: every 3rd round it dozes (Zzz) and skips its attack.
art_brief: Squat imp whose head is a broad red toadstool cap with cream spots. Knobbly tan skin, pot belly, long clawed fingers and toes. Burning yellow eyes under a heavy brow and a wide snarl of jagged teeth. Hunched forward with claws out, spoiling for a fight.
animations: idle: hunched sway, cap bobbing, claws flexing; attack: rears back, then a cap headbutt or spore punch that bursts into a spore cloud; hit: cap wobbles, winces; defeat: shrivels and sinks into the soil in a puff of spores. Extra: doze (skip turn) = slumps with a grumbling snore, one eye still open.

attack_flavor: Yips “你是谁?” at you, then pounces with a snapping paw swipe.
group_behavior: Packs of 2 in L1.3. If one falls, the other whimpers and its next attack is skipped.
special: None.
art_brief: Scrappy gray wolf pup with oversized paws and bristling fur. Piercing yellow eyes and a wrinkled snarl showing small sharp fangs. Pounces low and fast: young, but already a hunter.
animations: idle: low growl, hackles up, tail stiff; attack: crouch, then a pouncing snap with a paw swipe; hit: yelps, ears flat; defeat: backs away snarling, then flees.
variants: Darker gray pup as the Big Grey Wolf’s minion (same stats).

attack_flavor: A blur of fur yells “看!” and zips past, horn first, before you can even look.
sample_shout_en: to look; to watch; to read
group_behavior: Always alone, or with 1 horned rabbit. Scripted as path fight 6 of L1.3; afterwards a 10% rare patrol in L1.2–L1.3.
special: Quick Start: in round 1 it attacks before the hero’s first turn.
art_brief: Sleek electric-blue horned rabbit with a cream chest and exactly ONE yellow lightning-bolt horn. Brass aviator goggles are pushed up on its forehead. Narrowed eyes and a sharp-toothed smirk on a lean sprinter’s body, always coiled to dash.
animations: idle: bouncing on its toes, goggles glint; attack: crouch, then a horn-first dash across the screen leaving speed lines; hit: skids and spins; defeat: skids to a stop, panting, then zips off-screen.

attack_flavor: Squawks “什么? 什么?” and swoops for anything that sparkles, including your coins.
group_behavior: Location boss of L1.1, arrives with 1 horned rabbit it bosses around.
special: Coin Grab: once per battle a broken block also steals 3 gold; it drops all of it back when defeated.
art_brief: Big black crow in a red pirate bandana, with a massive curved yellow beak and a scowling glare under a heavy brow. Wings folded like crossed arms, a leather satchel of stolen gold coins on a shoulder strap, and sharp gray talons. The meadow’s pirate thug.
animations: idle: wings crossed, head cocked, glaring; attack: wings flare wide, then a lunging beak strike; hit: feathers burst out; defeat: drops the satchel (coins scatter) and flaps away squawking. Extra: steal (snatches a coin).

attack_flavor: Asks “你好吗?” in a too-sweet voice, then huffs a gust that knocks your hat off.
group_behavior: Location boss of L1.2, with 1 wolf pup (its nephew).
special: Big Huff: every 3rd turn it puffs its cheeks the turn before (telegraph); if you break that block you take +2 damage.
art_brief: Lanky gray wolf standing upright in a tattered white grandma nightgown and a lavender nightcap with a pom-pom. Hunched forward with long clawed hands, glinting yellow eyes and a wide sharp-toothed grin. The torn disguise fools nobody: a sly, predatory storybook villain.
animations: idle: hunched, fingers drumming, sly grin; attack: cheeks puff (telegraph), then a gust or a clawed swipe; hit: nightcap knocked askew, snarls; defeat: nightgown rips, nightcap flies off, and he slinks away into the hedges. Extra: telegraph (cheeks inflate).

attack_flavor: Booms “欢迎!” to his warren, then stomps so hard the carrots jump.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Starter Meadow, with 1 horned rabbit guard.
special: Royal Call: the first time he drops below 50% HP (the save checkpoint) he calls 1 horned rabbit if fewer than 3 enemies are on screen.
art_brief: Tall, upright gray-brown horned rabbit with exactly ONE sharp horn, glaring red eyes and bared buck teeth. A small gold crown set with rubies, a tattered crimson royal cape with gold trim fastened by a ruby clasp, and a gold scepter topped with a red orb. Scruffy, proud and cruel, he looks down on the hero.
animations: idle: cape stirs, taps the scepter, glares down; attack: scepter raised, then a horn-first lunge; hit: crown knocked askew, snarls; defeat: stumbles, drops the scepter and flees into the warren. Extra: summon (slams the scepter down).

attack_flavor: Buzzes “蜂蜜! 蜂蜜!” and pokes you with a round rubbery stinger.
group_behavior: Packs of 1–2. If you use a Honey Potion in battle, all bees stop and stare at it for one turn (skip attack).
special: None.
art_brief: Oversized, dog-sized bumblebee with dense yellow-and-black fur and translucent wings mid-beat. A scowling, furrowed brow over dark eyes, spiny black legs and a sharp dark stinger aimed forward. Territorial and aggressive.
animations: idle: hover bob with wing blur, glaring; attack: pulls back, then a stinger jab; hit: knocked spinning, wings stutter; defeat: drops low and buzzes off toward the hive.
variants: The Queen Bee’s summoned worker uses a separate sprite (worker_bee): smaller and sleeker, with a big glaring eye and the stinger thrust forward (half HP, no drops; spec v3).

attack_flavor: Offers you a berry, chirps “尝一尝!”, and sneaks a root under your feet.
group_behavior: Appears alone or with 1 giant bee.
special: Root Trip: a broken block roots the hero, so Flee is unavailable on the next turn.
art_brief: Knotted, bark-skinned tree sprite with thorny shoulder spikes and twig claws. A two-leaf sprout grows on its head and a pink blossom on its chest. Glowing amber eyes under a scowling brow. It stands in a fighter’s crouch and lashes out with a green vine whip.
animations: idle: fists clenched, leaves rustling; attack: vine whip lash (roots burst up for Root Trip); hit: bark chips fly, leaves shake; defeat: roots itself into the ground and goes still as a young tree.

attack_flavor: Mumbles “好吃… 好吃…” while eyeing you, and flings a gooey web ball.
group_behavior: Appears alone or in pairs; hangs from a thread on the top row of the battle screen.
special: Sticky Web: after a broken block the hero is webbed and their next attack deals half damage.
art_brief: Bulky forest spider whose body and legs are covered in thick green moss with bark-brown bands. Several glossy black eyes and a pair of curved ivory fangs. Crouched low, ready to lunge. Menacing but stylized, not realistic or hairy-creepy.
animations: idle: low crouch, legs shifting, fangs flexing; attack: rears up, then a fang lunge or a spat web ball; hit: legs curl in; defeat: scuttles backward into the undergrowth.

attack_flavor: Snaps “不要!” and thrusts its golden spear at your chest.
group_behavior: Alone or with 1 giant bee. Scripted as path fight 6 of L2.2; then a 10% rare patrol in L2.2.
special: Wax Shield: its wax shield absorbs the hero’s first hit of the battle (that hit deals only 1).
art_brief: Bee soldier in ornate golden plate armor with a honeycomb pattern and a crested helmet with a red plume. Fierce eyes glare through the visor. It carries a long golden spear and a round, honeycomb-embossed golden shield. Disciplined and rigid, ready to skewer intruders.
animations: idle: shield up, spear upright, wings humming; attack: spear drawn back, then a full-length thrust; hit: shield clangs, staggers; defeat: drops its shield and retreats to the hive. Extra: shield block (first hit).

minions: 1 Giant Bee (chasing the bear, but angry at everyone)
attack_flavor: Rumbles “饿!” and belly-bumps you out of the way of the honey.
group_behavior: Location boss of L2.1, with 1 giant bee chasing it.
special: Snack Break: once, the first time it drops below 50% HP, it licks honey from its paw and heals 8 HP.
art_brief: Hulking brown bear with a paw-print napkin tied around its neck. Honey drips from snarling jaws full of teeth, it has long curved claws, and it clutches a dented honey pot. Greedy and furious at anyone near its honey.
animations: idle: hunched, growling, honey dripping; attack: rears up, then a clawed swipe or honey-pot slam; hit: roars, honey splashes; defeat: lumbers off into the trees clutching its pot. Extra: snack heal (gulps honey from the pot).

attack_flavor: Demands “请给我…” in her royal voice, then sends a shockwave buzz.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Honeycomb Forest, with 1 giant bee.
special: Summon Worker (v3): every 3 turns she summons 1 small worker bee (half normal HP, no gold, EXP or chest) if fewer than 3 enemies are on screen, max 2 summons per fight. Defeating her makes all bees fly home (the battle ends).
art_brief: Huge regal queen bee with a long black-and-gold striped abdomen ending in a prominent stinger. A spiked gold crown, a golden armored collar set with a violet gem, translucent wings and a cold, furious glare. Imperious and dangerous, she hovers above her hive.
animations: idle: slow hover, wings shimmering, glaring down; attack: rears back, then a stinger jab with a buzzing shockwave; hit: recoils, crown slips; defeat: retreats into the heart of the hive, wings drooping. Extra: summon (commanding gesture; a worker bursts from the comb).

attack_flavor: Yells “钱包!” and tries to swipe the wallet right off your belt.
group_behavior: Pairs. If one falls, the other shouts 快跑 and flees next turn, dropping its gold pouch (normal drops).
special: None.
art_brief: Wiry road bandit in a patched green hood with a cloth bandana over the lower face. A precarious stack of stolen hats sits on his head and stolen wallets hang from his belt. Narrowed eyes and a sneering grin; he crouches with a padded cudgel, ready to jump you.
animations: idle: shifty crouch, eyes darting; attack: lunging grab for your wallet; hit: hat stack wobbles; defeat: hats topple and he sprints off. Extra: flee.
variants: Red hood and blue hood palette swaps.

attack_flavor: Burbles its own color, “绿色!”, and belly-flops on your boots.
group_behavior: Groups of 2 (L3.2) that bounce in sync. Sometimes hides inside market baskets.
special: Color Shout: its bark always names its current color (red, blue, yellow or green variant).
art_brief: Glossy translucent jelly with a coin suspended inside, two narrow glowing eyes and a wide gummy frown baring rows of jelly teeth. It swells up before it lunges.
animations: idle: menacing pulse, swelling and shrinking; attack: rears high, then a body slam; hit: ripples violently; defeat: splats into a puddle that slithers away.
variants: Color variants: green (default), red, blue, yellow; bark changes to match (红色/蓝色/黄色).

attack_flavor: Whispers “礼物…” like a gift, then snaps its lid shut on your sleeve.
group_behavior: Always alone. Disguised as a map chest; scripted in L3.2, and 1 in 10 map chests in realm 3 is a mimic.
special: Surprise: it acts first in round 1. Its chest chance is higher (25%, elite rule).
art_brief: Iron-banded wooden treasure chest with a long lolling tongue and rows of blunt wooden fang-pegs along the lid. Narrow yellow eyes glow from the keyhole. It springs open to bite.
animations: idle: sits still as a chest, then a keyhole eye flicks open; attack: lid flies open and chomps; hit: lid rattles, coins bounce out; defeat: lid falls open, tongue limp, coins spill.
variants: Plain wooden chest and red-lacquer chest skins.

attack_flavor: Sneers “多少钱?”, as in how much you’ve got, and swings a big foam-padded club.
group_behavior: Location boss of L3.1 who runs a fake toll gate, with 1 road bandit.
special: Pay Up!: every 3rd turn he taps his club the turn before (telegraph); a broken block on that attack takes +3 damage.
art_brief: Barrel-chested bandit chief with a bushy red beard, an eye patch, a coin-studded vest and a heavy padded club with a price tag. Scowling gap-toothed snarl; he looms over the road like a wall.
animations: idle: slaps the club into his palm, glowering; attack: club wind-up, then a crushing swing; hit: coins fly from the vest; defeat: trips, eye patch flips up, and he flees down the road. Extra: telegraph (club tap).

attack_flavor: Brags “第一!”, number one treasure in town, and slams its giant lid.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Crossroads Market, with 1 slime that pops out of its lid.
special: Lid Shut: every 3rd turn it shuts its lid; the hero’s next attack deals half damage unless the answer is spoken.
art_brief: Giant gilded treasure chest wearing a jeweled crown, with a purple tongue and gems for eyes that glare coldly. Rows of gold-tooth pegs line the lid and coins spill from its jaws. Vain, greedy and eager to crush.
animations: idle: lid breathing open and shut, coins rattling; attack: jump, then a lid slam (screen shake); hit: gems crack; defeat: bursts open, showering coins and a shield, and slumps empty. Extra: lid shut, slime pop-out.

attack_flavor: Squeaks “小朋友!” from behind you, then nips your ear.
group_behavior: Swarms of 2–3. They flit; when only one is left it tries to hang upside down and hide (skips a turn).
special: None.
art_brief: Small purple cave bat with huge ribbed ears, glowing yellow eyes, bared needle fangs and tattered wings. It dives in jittery zigzags.
animations: idle: jittery flutter, fangs bared; attack: zigzag dive and nip; hit: tumbles midair; defeat: flees back into the dark ceiling.

attack_flavor: Cackles “开始!” and flicks a pebble at you before you’re ready.
group_behavior: Groups of 2–3. If the hero gets a streak of 3+, one goblin argues 不公平! and skips its attack.
special: None.
art_brief: Short green goblin with long pointed ears, a backwards cap and a stolen school backpack. Crooked sharp teeth in a sneering grin as it cocks a slingshot. Bratty and mean.
animations: idle: bounces on its heels, jeering; attack: slingshot pull and release; hit: cap flies off; defeat: stumbles back and runs off shouting 我输了.
variants: Three skin tones (green, olive, teal) and cap colors.

attack_flavor: Rings a bell, shouts “上课!”, and smacks its desk with a ruler (and your knuckles).
sample_shout_en: to start class; to attend class
group_behavior: Appears with 1–2 goblins, standing at the back and bossing them.
special: Roll Call: once per battle, if it is the last enemy standing, it rings its bell and 1 goblin joins.
art_brief: Goblin in a crooked prefect sash and round glasses, with a giant ruler raised like a weapon and a hand bell in the other fist. Eyes narrowed, teeth bared: a petty tyrant.
animations: idle: slaps the ruler in its palm, glaring over its glasses; attack: ruler swing; hit: glasses knocked askew; defeat: drops the sash and scurries off. Extra: bell ring (summon).

attack_flavor: Grunts “作业!”, lifts a whole school desk overhead, and slams it down.
group_behavior: Alone or with 1 goblin. Scripted in L4.2; 10% rare patrol in all three Goblin Caves locations.
special: Big Swing: every 3rd turn it lifts the desk (telegraph); a broken block on that attack takes +3 damage.
art_brief: Hulking goblin with a tiny head, huge arms and a school uniform bursting at the seams, a wooden desk hefted overhead. Jutting underbite tusks and a furious glare.
animations: idle: heavy breathing, flexing, desk on its shoulder; attack: desk overhead, then a slam; hit: staggers; defeat: the desk crashes down beside it and it lumbers away. Extra: telegraph lift.

attack_flavor: Screeches “我不懂!” so loudly the words bounce around the cave.
group_behavior: Location boss of L4.1, with 1 cave bat.
special: Echo: every 3rd turn its defense question re-asks the last item the kid missed this battle (if any), same way.
art_brief: Big lavender bat with satellite-dish ears and wide leathery wings spread across the cave ceiling. A broad fanged maw ringed by visible sound waves and glowing eyes. Loud and theatrical.
animations: idle: hangs, ears swiveling, glowing eyes tracking the hero; attack: rears back, then a screech with sound-wave rings; hit: ears ring (stars); defeat: folds its wings and retreats into the dark. Extra: echo (rings pulse).

attack_flavor: Jingles its keys, hisses “请安静!”, and whirls the big key ring like a flail.
group_behavior: Location boss of L4.2 guarding the school gate, with 1 goblin.
special: Drops the School Gate Key (story item) that opens L4.3.
art_brief: Stocky goblin warden in an oversized iron helmet, with a huge ring of keys on its belt and a padlock-shaped shield. It glares through the visor slit with a snaggle-toothed snarl, guarding the school gate and letting no one through.
animations: idle: shield up, keys jangling, glaring; attack: key-ring whirl like a flail; hit: keys scatter; defeat: drops the big golden key and flees, helmet over its eyes.

attack_flavor: Bellows “考试!” and slams a stack of fake test papers down like a hammer.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Goblin Caves. He kidnapped the village kids and their teacher to run a fake school where goblins always win.
special: School Bell: the first time he drops below 50% HP (checkpoint) he rings the bell and 1 goblin rejoins if fewer than 3 enemies. When defeated, the kids and the teacher are freed and cheer 谢谢!
art_brief: Fat goblin in a tattered graduation gown with a crown worn over a mortarboard, tiny spectacles, a giant pointer stick and a stack of test papers. He sneers with yellowed fangs: a tyrant posing as a headmaster.
animations: idle: taps the pointer on a chalkboard, sneering; attack: paper-stack slam; hit: papers flutter everywhere; defeat: gown rips, crown rolls away, and he dives under a desk. Extra: bell ring.

attack_flavor: Gurgles “迟到!” and drags you into the mud so you really will be late.
group_behavior: Groups of 2–3 that rise out of the mud together.
special: Muddy: a broken block makes the hero muddy, so their next attack deals 2 less damage.
art_brief: Lumpy green-brown mud creature with lily pads and cattails sprouting from its back, glowing eyes and a dripping maw. It rises from the swamp with heavy mud-caked arms.
animations: idle: bubbles popping, looming; attack: scoops and hurls mud; hit: splats flat, then reforms; defeat: sinks back into the swamp, leaving a lily pad.

attack_flavor: Hisses “马上!” and whips its tail before you can blink.
group_behavior: Pairs. The hydra’s helpers: they always come with it as minions.
special: None.
art_brief: Lean teal lizard with a flared frilled collar, slit-pupil eyes, needle teeth, a whip-like curled tail and a pocket watch on a chain. Twitchy and quick to strike.
animations: idle: checks the watch, frill twitching, hissing; attack: spin and tail whip; hit: frill snaps open; defeat: scrambles off on two legs, dropping its watch.

attack_flavor: Whispers “晚上…” and flickers a cold blue flash that drains your magic.
group_behavior: Alone, or with 1 bog monster. Scripted in L5.1; 10% rare patrol in Hydra Swamp. Found only at night on the map.
special: Glow Drain: a broken block also drains 3 MP.
art_brief: Floating teardrop of cold blue-green flame with hollow glowing eyes and a thin, wicked smile. It trails mist and lures travelers off the path.
animations: idle: slow float and eerie flicker; attack: dims, then a cold flash; hit: flame gutters; defeat: shrinks to a spark and fades into the mist.

attack_flavor: Croaks “一会儿…” in a bored voice and lashes out its sticky tongue.
group_behavior: Location boss of L5.1, with 1 bog monster.
special: Pocket Grab: every 3rd turn its tongue grabs your potion bag, so potions can’t be used on the hero’s next turn.
art_brief: Giant olive toad in a sagging nightcap, with warty skin, a heavy-lidded glare and a huge wide mouth hiding a long sticky tongue coiled to lash. Grumpy and territorial.
animations: idle: slow breathing, throat pulsing, glaring; attack: tongue lash; hit: puffs up round; defeat: sinks into the mud with a sulky croak. Extra: potion-bag grab.

attack_flavor: Its heads all ask “现在几点?” at once, then snap one after another.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Hydra Swamp, with 2 bog lizards.
special: Double Bite: every 3rd turn two heads attack (two defense questions, each blocked separately). Every 25% HP lost, one head gets tired and ducks under the water (visual only).
art_brief: Big teal swamp serpent with nine heads on long necks, each with its own glare (one sneering, one hissing, one in spectacles), fin-like ears and fanged jaws. The heads squabble but all turn on the hero.
animations: idle: heads weave and hiss; attack: heads strike in sequence; hit: heads recoil and bonk each other; defeat: heads tangle into a knot and it sinks with bubbles. Extra: double bite, head duck-under.

attack_flavor: Moans “我头疼…” and lurches forward with grasping hands.
group_behavior: Groups of 3 that shuffle in slowly. They are sick villagers, not monsters.
special: Cure: at 0 HP it isn’t destroyed; a puff of sparkly green mist clears and it turns back into a villager who says 谢谢! (same drops).
art_brief: Sick villager with pale green skin, glowing green eyes, a thermometer in its mouth, a bandaged arm (no wounds), a torn scarf and farm clothes, arms outstretched in a lurching grab. Eerie and menacing, but no rot or gore.
animations: idle: slow sway, moaning; attack: lurch and grab; hit: staggers, sneezes; defeat: green mist swirls away, leaving a dazed, healthy villager. Extra: cure transform.
variants: Farmer, baker and grandma outfits (same stats).

attack_flavor: Rattles “找… 找…” while hunting for its missing rib, then throws a spare bone like a boomerang.
group_behavior: Pairs that clatter in step. If one falls, the other stops to look for its bones (skips a turn).
special: None.
art_brief: Skeleton with a lopsided top hat, red pinpoint lights in its eye sockets, a clacking jaw and one missing rib, winding up to throw a bone boomerang. Stylized and clean, no gore.
animations: idle: rattling, jaw clacking; attack: bone boomerang throw; hit: jaw knocked loose and snapped back; defeat: collapses into a pile of bones topped by the hat.

attack_flavor: Sighs “我累了…”, drags its dull sword and swings it anyway.
group_behavior: Alone or with 1 zombie. Scripted in L6.2; 10% rare patrol in Zombie Lands. It was the village guard captain.
special: Shield Up: every 3rd turn it raises its shield, halving the hero’s damage that round. It is cured at 0 HP like other zombies.
art_brief: Hulking knight in dented, oversized armor with a green-tinged face and glowing eyes behind the visor. A drooping plume, a blanket for a cape, and a heavy dull sword dragged along the ground.
animations: idle: heavy breathing, visor clanks; attack: slow, crushing overhead swing; hit: armor rattles; defeat: green mist leaves and the captain sinks to one knee, cured. Extra: shield up, cure transform.

attack_flavor: Mumbles “别担心…” out of old habit, then thumps his cane.
group_behavior: Location boss of L6.1, with 1 zombie.
special: Cure at 0 HP. When cured he gives the Village Key and tells you where the sickness came from.
art_brief: Round, sick-green village mayor with a sash, top hat, monocle and cane, an ice pack tied on his head. Glowing green eyes and an unsettling empty grin.
animations: idle: sways, monocle glinting; attack: cane thump with a small shockwave; hit: ice pack slips; defeat: cure transform, and he sits down dazed.

attack_flavor: Cackles “生病!” and sneezes a swirling green cloud at you.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Zombie Lands, a minion the Demon King sent to make the villagers sick. With 2 zombies.
special: Germ Call: every 3 turns it calls 1 zombie if fewer than 3 enemies are on screen. Defeating it cures every zombie on screen at once.
art_brief: Floating green gremlin made of swirling, sickly cloud, with small horns, a runny red nose, a tattered doctor’s coat, a sharp grin and a bubbling potion flask. Gleeful malice.
animations: idle: floats, sniffling, cackling; attack: big inhale, then a sneeze cloud; hit: the cloud puffs apart and reforms; defeat: shrinks into a tiny sneeze and pops. Extra: summon.

attack_flavor: Screeches “往左走!”, then dives at you from the right with a flurry of feathers.
group_behavior: Flocks of 2–3 that circle overhead.
special: None.
art_brief: Bird-woman with storm-grey wings for arms, taloned bird legs and wild cloud-shaped hair. Piercing yellow eyes and a screeching mouth, with a raincloud swirling over her head.
animations: idle: hover, wingbeats slow and threatening, cloud drizzling; attack: wing flap and feather volley; hit: feathers ruffled; defeat: the raincloud breaks up and she flees into the sky.
variants: Snow variant for L7.2 (bark 下雪).

attack_flavor: Caws “上!”, climbs into the clouds, then dives claws-first.
group_behavior: Pairs or a trio. They are proud, not evil: under the spell of their bewitched king.
special: None.
art_brief: Golden-brown griffin with a white-feathered eagle head, fierce amber eyes and a hooked beak open in a screech. Lion body with a tufted tail, talons spread for a dive.
animations: idle: wings half-raised, tail lashing; attack: rise, then a dive swoop; hit: feathers fly; defeat: shakes off the spell (purple sparkles leave its eyes) and flies away.

attack_flavor: Rumbles “一直走…” and marches straight at you, no matter what’s in the way.
group_behavior: Always alone. Scripted in L7.1; 10% rare patrol in Griffin Peaks. It guards the mountain road.
special: Straight Line: it only walks straight; if the hero blocked its last attack, it bumps into a rock and skips its next turn.
art_brief: Blocky mossy stone giant with glowing blue rune eyes, a signpost jammed into its shoulder, fists like boulders and a bird’s nest on its head. Slow, relentless and crushing.
animations: idle: grinding breath, pebbles falling, runes pulsing; attack: heavy stomp forward (screen shake); hit: chips fly; defeat: sinks down and hardens into a mossy hill. Extra: bump-into-rock.

attack_flavor: Roars “远!” and blasts you far across the cliff with a whirling gale.
group_behavior: Location boss of L7.1. A wild dragon (not evil) that guards its cliff; a harpy rides its winds.
special: Respect: every 3rd turn it uses Gale Breath; if the hero blocks it, the dragon is impressed and skips its next attack. When defeated it bows and lets you pass (it can become an ally later in the story).
art_brief: Long serpentine sky-blue Chinese-style dragon with a cloud-like mane, pearl whiskers, bared fangs and swirling wind trails. Its eyes flash a warning: wild and territorial, not evil, still majestic.
animations: idle: coils in the air, mane streaming, growling; attack: rears up, then a gale-breath swirl; hit: coils tighten; defeat: lands, lowers its head, and flies off into the clouds. Extra: impressed (a slow nod).

attack_flavor: Commands “出发!” and leads a lightning-charged dive from the storm clouds.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Griffin Peaks, bewitched by the Demon King’s storm crown. With 2 griffins.
special: Royal Dive: every 3rd turn he circles up (telegraph) and dives; a broken block on that attack takes +50%. Defeating him breaks the storm crown and frees all griffins.
art_brief: Majestic white-and-gold griffin with a lightning-shaped purple crown crackling with dark sparks. Glassy, spellbound eyes, a hooked beak open in a war cry, and storm clouds around its wings.
animations: idle: wings half-open, crown crackling; attack: soar up, then a lightning dive; hit: crown flickers; defeat: the crown shatters into sparkles, his eyes clear, and he lands. Extra: telegraph circle.

attack_flavor: Yells “踢足球!” and kicks a boulder at you like a soccer ball.
group_behavior: Pairs or 1 with an ogre gladiator.
special: Regrow (cosmetic): green sparkles and a taunt when a round passes without it being hit; no healing.
art_brief: Tall lanky blue-green troll with a long nose, shaggy moss hair, a sweatband and a number 9 jersey. Jutting tusks and a mean grin as it winds up to kick a boulder.
animations: idle: juggles a rock on its knee, sneering; attack: boulder kick; hit: stumbles; defeat: trips over its boulder and limps off. Extra: regrow sparkle.
variants: Two jersey colors (red team, blue team).

attack_flavor: Bellows “胜利!” at the crowd and crashes down with a padded club.
group_behavior: Groups of 2–3 in L8.2. The crowd cheers the hero when a gladiator falls.
special: None.
art_brief: Big orange ogre with a single jutting tusk, a horned helmet too small for his head, a padded club and a bottle-cap belt. Scowling and roaring to the crowd.
animations: idle: flexes and roars to the crowd; attack: club overhead crash; hit: helmet spins; defeat: drops to one knee and concedes.

attack_flavor: Crackles “跳舞!” and twirls into a spinning ring of flame.
group_behavior: Always alone: the arena’s fire-pit show act. Scripted in L8.2; 10% rare patrol in the Colosseum.
special: Toasty: a broken block leaves the hero toasty, losing 3 HP at the end of the next round.
art_brief: Figure of roaring orange and yellow flame with a white-hot core, blazing eyes and a flaming mohawk, arms flung wide as it spins into a fire ring. Showy and dangerous.
animations: idle: flaring flame dance; attack: spins into a fire ring; hit: flames shrink and sputter; defeat: fizzles down to embers.

attack_flavor: Snorts “比赛!” and charges across the arena, horns first.
group_behavior: Location boss of L8.1 (qualifier final), with 1 arena troll.
special: Charge: every 3rd turn it scrapes its hoof (telegraph); a broken block on that attack takes +50%.
art_brief: Muscular bull-headed warrior with brown fur, a brass nose ring, a red cape and sweatbands. Steam blasts from its nostrils and its horns are lowered to charge.
animations: idle: snorting steam, hoof scraping; attack: head-down charge; hit: horns ring; defeat: staggers and yields the arena. Extra: telegraph (hoof scrape).

attack_flavor: Laughs “没问题!” and slams the ground so hard the crowd bounces.
group_behavior: Realm boss of Ogre Colosseum, the undefeated champ, with 2 ogre gladiators.
special: Show-off: every 3rd turn he poses for the crowd instead of attacking; the hero’s next correct attack deals +50%.
art_brief: Gigantic ogre with a shiny champion belt, a laurel wreath, a flowing purple cape and a huge padded hammer raised overhead, wearing a cocky tusked sneer.
animations: idle: flexes to the crowd, hammer on shoulder; attack: hammer ground slam (screen shake); hit: belt jolts; defeat: drops to one knee and hands over the belt. Extra: show-off pose.

attack_flavor: Snickers “其实…”, starting a fib, then pokes you with a tiny pitchfork.
group_behavior: Groups of 3 that snicker and swap places. If two fall, the last one hides behind a curtain (skips a turn).
special: None.
art_brief: Small red imp with stubby horns, bat wings, a barbed tail and a small pitchfork. A sly fanged grin and glowing yellow eyes: mischievous and spiteful.
animations: idle: darting flight, cackling; attack: pitchfork poke; hit: spins like a top; defeat: pops in a puff of red smoke.

attack_flavor: Roars “攻击!” and swings a sword trailing purple smoke.
group_behavior: Pairs, or 1 with 2 imps. The Demon King’s guards.
special: Dark Guard: the hero’s first hit on it each battle deals half damage.
art_brief: Knight in black-and-purple armor with rounded spikes, glowing red eye slits, short horns on the helmet and a smoky cape, sword raised with a purple trail.
animations: idle: sword planted, cape billowing; attack: slash with a purple trail; hit: armor sparks; defeat: the armor falls apart empty and a puff of smoke escapes.

attack_flavor: Suddenly wakes up, “终于!”, at last someone to scare, and pounces from its pedestal.
group_behavior: Alone or with 1 imp. Scripted in L9.1; 10% rare patrol in the castle. Looks like a statue until the fight starts.
special: Stone Sleep: it starts as a statue and wakes when hit or at the end of round 2, whichever comes first.
art_brief: Grey stone winged beast with a snarling dog-like face, stubby horns, cracked wings and moss patches, crouched on a pedestal with claws gripping the edge.
animations: idle (statue): motionless except one eye snapping open; awake idle: wings flare, snarling; attack: pounce; hit: chips fly; defeat: freezes back into a statue mid-snarl.

attack_flavor: Growls “力量…” in the Demon King’s voice and breathes purple shadow fire.
group_behavior: Location boss of L9.1: a good dragon corrupted by the Demon King. An imp holds its curse chain.
special: Curse Chain: while the imp is up, the dragon’s ATK is +3. Defeating the dragon breaks the curse: it turns golden, says 谢谢 and becomes an ally in the final battle story.
art_brief: Huge long Chinese-style dragon with golden scales half-covered in cracked purple shadow crust, glowing violet eyes, bared fangs and a dark chain collar; gold light leaks through the cracks. Dangerous while cursed, tragic rather than evil.
animations: idle: coils, shadow smoke drifts off; attack: rears and breathes purple fire; hit: shadow cracks show gold light; defeat: shadow shatters, the golden dragon rises and bows. Extra: curse-break transform.
variants: Golden freed form (ally/NPC art, not an enemy).

attack_flavor: Thunders “统治!” and slams his scepter, sending out a wave of dark power.
group_behavior: Final boss, with 2 demon knights. He wants to rule all races (humans, elves, dwarves, orcs, dragons) by force.
special: Two phases: at 50% HP (checkpoint) his cape turns red and he calls up to 2 demon knights (max 3 on screen). Every 4th turn he charges Rule by Force (telegraph); a broken block on it takes +50%.
art_brief: A tall caped demon lord with curling ram horns, a crown of black spikes, glowing golden eyes, a purple-and-black cloak and a scepter with a red gem. Dramatic, theatrical, arrogant smirk; imposing but not grotesque.
animations: idle: cape billows, scepter gem pulses; attack: scepter slam + dark wave; hit: staggers, crown tilts; defeat: shrinks into a small grumpy imp-sized demon and flees. Extra: phase-2 transform (cape turns red), summon, telegraph charge.
